question: What is the first nonvanishing scalar action after the enhanced local-rest lapse constraint has removed the quadratic finite-k propagator?

variables.y: Y-1; the quadratic constraint implies y starts at O(phi^2)

target_power_counting: because y=O(phi^2), the bracket starts at O(phi^4)
therefore F/Y=1+O(phi) cannot affect the quartic action
the quartic lapse equation is (-Delta+mu_K^2)y=mu_K^2 J
after eliminating y, S4/M_Pl^2 = integral J [mu_K^2(-Delta)/(mu_K^2-Delta)] J, a positive spatial functional with no time derivative at quartic order

decision_rule.if_all_identities_hold: classify the first nonzero constrained local-rest scalar action as quartic and purely spatial; retain the rank-enhancement/strong-coupling warning and proceed to the first time-dependent nonlinear order plus higher-spatial rescue
decision_rule.if_a_time_derivative_survives_at_quartic: derive it explicitly and reassess the rank-enhancement interpretation

non_claims: does not prove the scalar is absent nonlinearly
does not yet prove a finite or zero strong-coupling energy scale
does not include higher-spatial gravity operators
does not apply to the rolling cosmological branch
does not cover nonzero background invariant shift, k=0, compact-object X_U->0 or DBI-boundary configurations
next_gate_if_pass: derive the first time-dependent constrained nonlinear term (at least quintic by this counting) and separately test a minimal higher-spatial operator that restores a quadratic local mode without altering the already-certified cosmological and PPN sectors
